title: ENDEX — Evening Picture, Three Confirmations

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is 12:40 on Monday, October 12, 2026, and with compressed time the Monday evening picture is in: about 90 coded cases on the line list, counted by onset. One is confirmed by GI PCR (Salmonella, HD26-003; culture still pending) and one is hospitalized (HD26-009). The curve by onset hour shows a point source at the Saturday supper with a tail. Before we close, three confirmations, read aloud: first, the Director states the status of Prairie Table Catering for Tuesday's 11:30 senior meal (documented voluntary hold, signed embargo or closure order) and states that the Kessler traceback has gone to FDA through Iowa HHS and that MCHD is not contacting the vendor. Second, the PIO states the next public update time and confirms that the MCHD, MRMC and school district figures match. Third, the Epidemiology Lead records the open after-action items from the 2026 improvement plan. This concludes the exercise.
finalState: Line list: about 90 coded cases by onset; 1 confirmed (HD26-003, Salmonella, serotyping pending); 1 hospitalized (HD26-009).
Epi curve by onset hour: a point source at the Saturday October 10 supper (service 17:00–19:30), with a tail.
Kessler produce traceback: passed to FDA through Iowa HHS. MCHD has not contacted the vendor. WGS on the MRMC isolate is not expected before later in the week.

Open 2026 improvement plan items: one after-hours duty phone with no text capability; a shared line list spreadsheet that breaks when two people edit at once; no Spanish version of the school letter template (translation takes four hours).
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Hang up any open calls, close the line list and put down your notes. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash here in the conference room.
fields.hotWashMethod: Timeline walk-back against MOISOP 9 targets, then 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well and three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: When did we have a working case definition, an outbreak declaration, a first control measure and a public notice, measured from Reddy's 08:40 call? How do those times compare with the 8, 12 and 24-hour targets?
Did every number that went out (radio, MRMC post, school letter, Health Advisory, TV) come from the line list at a stated time, and where did they first stop matching?
What did we decide about Prairie Table before the attack-rate table could separate coleslaw from pasta salad, and what in writing supported it?
How did the duplicate HD26-015 and the conflicted copy affect the count, and what fixes the single-editor spreadsheet before the next event?
Who was left out: the 12 unreachable ticket holders, the Spanish-speaking families, the food handlers and the preschool aide? What would we do differently?
fields.facilitatorNote: Record the measured times: first report (08:40) to case definition, to outbreak declaration, to first control measure and to public notice. Record whether the MCHD, MRMC and district figures matched exactly. Compare the team's curve with the master line list by onset, not by report date. Collect the line list snapshots, the signed hold or embargo paperwork, the special courier authorization and the evaluator sheets before the break.
fields.scenarioTitle: Side Dish — Supper Outbreak, Line List & One Count

instructorNote: This card closes play. The Director, PIO and Epi Lead each give their confirmation aloud. Write down the four measured times against the MOISOP 9 targets and note whether the numbers matched exactly across MCHD, MRMC and the district. Then check the team's curve against the line list by onset before you open the hot wash.
